result.title: Rethinking weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs: position nulls, protocol dependence, and PACE
result.summary: Weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs is reported as a single overlap accuracy, and those numbers are not comparable across papers. We measure what one contains. Against position-null controls that keep a readout's own box and move only its position, class activation mapping and its gradient-weighted variant beat the null on two to four of seven annotated findings on ChestX-ray14 and two of eight on CheXlocalize. The null is beatable: three board-certified radiologists clear it on four to seven. Three rarely stated choices each move a result by more than most reported method effects: the results regime, the extraction threshold, and the mask-to-box rule, whose cost is predicted by how fragmented the thresholded mask is. Predicted box area alone reverses a paired comparison. These measurements produced PACE, for \emph{population anomaly and class evidence}, which multiplies the finding identity from the label-trained head by the spatial evidence from a frozen radiograph backbone that never sees a pathology label. It is the case study that made the protocol dependence visible, and we report its costs beside its gain: in an exploratory matched-area analysis it improves strict-overlap accuracy on both corpora and beats a label-derived second map, but it is the least faithful of the three readouts to the classifier's causal map, its advantage depends on the box rule, and, this benchmark releasing no localization validation set, every design choice behind it was made on the boxes it is scored on. Its one clean transfer beats one baseline and loses to the other.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以胸片弱监督定位为对象，用「位置零对照」检验 CAM 类读出是否真有空间信号，量化结果制度、阈值与掩码转框规则等协议选择对结论的影响，并提出 PACE 方法并同时报告其收益与代价。
AI.relevance_reason: 其位置零对照及「读出是否忠实于分类器因果图」的诊断，可能可供核查 VLM/LVR 中视觉证据图是否真正承载空间证据而非位置先验；协议选择左右结论的提醒，也可能类比到 latent 视觉证据的评价设计。
